text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
<username>!
I have some truly wonderful news for you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm a member of the
Umamusume of the Year Selection Committee, and—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I bring good news from the URA.
You might have already received an email about it,
but I wanted to let you know just in case.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, we had a guest?
My apologies."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
We likely need the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Then please take this.
Opening the letter handed to me—

"To <chrname>.
We are pleased to inform you that you have been
selected as this year's Best Classic Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: "Yes. This award is determined and chosen based on an overall assessment of the entire year's performance."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It is not something just anyone can obtain.
Thereforeâ

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Splendid. That single word says it all. As someone associated with this academy, I feel immensely proud.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Even so, that doesn't mean your Twinkle Series is over.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Without letting your guard down,
please run your way through the Senior Class as well.
Afterward, <chrname> and I promised each other to keep doing our best together next year as well.
